integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by independently coded exact finite-model checks; finite checks do not establish infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic theorem applies to uniformly recursive trees with independent edge cuts and N times the cut probability approaching a finite constant. The walk result applies to uniform binary fresh steps, at even terminal times. No quantitative rate or general finite-group result is claimed. Classical fringe profiles and thinning arguments are acknowledged; general-priority coverage remains a potential risk.
title: Poisson fringe defects and a sharp near-complete-reinforcement mixing window
